description: This file contains a set of helper functions designed to parse and analyze Robot Framework test files (.robot). It extracts variables, processes keywords, and determines required variables for specific test cases by inspecting the structure and content of the robot files.

methods.name: str _normalize_var(name: str)
methods.description: Normalizes a variable name to a canonical form by stripping whitespace.

methods.name: Set[str] _extract_vars_from_text(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts variable references like ${VAR}, @{LIST}, &{DICT} from text using regular expressions.

methods.name: bool _is_assignment_token(token_val: str)
methods.description: Checks if a token string indicates a variable assignment (e.g., ${X}=).

methods.name: Set[str] _assigned_vars(keyword_node)
methods.description: Extracts variables assigned within a keyword definition, including arguments and set variable statements.

methods.name: Set[str] _extract_file_level_variables(model)
methods.description: Extracts variables defined in the Variables section of the robot file.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_keyword_map(model)
methods.description: Builds a mapping of keyword names to their definitions.

methods.name: Optional[str] _find_best_keyword_match(call_name: str, kw_map: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Finds the best matching keyword definition for a call, prioritizing exact, then prefix, then substring match.

methods.name: Set[str] _process_keywords( testcase_node, kw_map: Dict[str, Any], visited: Set[str], assigned_in_visited_keywords: Set[str] )
methods.description: Recursively processes keywords within a test case to identify used variables, tracking assignments to avoid false positives.

methods.name: Set[str] _cleanup_candidates(vars_set: Set[str], assigned_in_visited: Set[str], file_level_vars: Set[str])
methods.description: Filters out system, built-in, file-level, and variables assigned within visited keywords from the set of candidate variables.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_required_variables_for_case(content: str, case_name: str, test_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Main function: Parses a Robot Framework file content to find a specified test case and determines which variables it requires, considering variable assignments and keyword calls.

ctags.name: _process_keywords
ctags.signature: ( testcase_node, kw_map: Dict[str, Any], visited: Set[str], assigned_in_visited_keywords: Set[str] )

ctags.name: get_required_variables_for_case
ctags.pattern: /^def get_required_variables_for_case(content: str, case_name: str, test_id: Optional[int] = None)/
ctags.signature: (content: str, case_name: str, test_id: Optional[int] = None)
